svg.title: Counterexamples enter the page plan
svg.desc: Move those complications into the page plan with their identities intact. Evidence resisting the thesis changes selection rather than being hidden in an unreadable margin.

**Location:** `curt-home-office`

**Frame:** Curt moves the complicating facts into the page plan rather than discarding them. Earlier chapter guardrails and counterexamples light up.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> He's describing them. He's also describing me. I don't have their incentive. I have a thesis, which is worse, because it doesn't show up on a balance sheet.
>
> The fit is a reason to investigate harder, not permission to simplify.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` — creator method; Curt's application of the critic's point to himself is his own, not the post's.
